mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances corporate earnings prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of non-recession quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthening housing demand, foreshadows broader consumer spending growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, indicating rising inflation pressures, and FEDFUNDS is above 3%, investors anticipate tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4%, coupled with RSAFS growth above $500B, signals a labor market-driven consumption boost, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved supply chain efficiency, enhances corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 48% of easing cycle months with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
